hypothesis: Larger spatial image context corrects shared Eutectic errors
input: Frozen train70 base OOF log probabilities and image gray
model: Four dilated convolutions d1/2/4/8 width16; RF31; zero initialized scalar Eutectic residual bounded +/-1
training: 4 grouped meta-folds; hold one fold out; 400 updates per fold; batch4 patch192; AdamW1e-3; fixed last checkpoint; seed81900+fold
loss: .5 fourclass CE + .5 Eutectic binary CE + .05 residual squared
validation: train70 held-fold meta OOF only; no valid/test reads
limitation: Base OOF is reused, not retrained inside meta split. This is exploratory meta-OOF, not independent nested generalization evidence.
gpu: 3 only if idle; sibling fcntl locks; stop our child on foreign compute
